LOCATIONS <- list(ARL="../credentials/credentials-remote-ARL.yaml",
                  #SSA_DEV="/credentials/credentials-remote-dev.yaml",
                  #SSA_PROD="/credentials/credentials-remote-RSF.yaml",
                  #Jason_DEV_Shafique="/credentials/credentials-rsfjson-rsfshafique.yaml",
                  Jason_DEV=here::here("./credentials/credentials-rsfjson-rsfdev.yaml"),
                  Jason_PROD=here::here("./credentials/credentials-rsfjson-rsfprod.yaml"))

LOCATION <- "Jason_DEV"

credentials_list <- yaml.load_file(here::here(LOCATIONS[[LOCATION]]))

dbStart <- function(credentials_list,
                    ob_name,
                    drv=DBI::dbDriver("Postgres"),
                    destination="Postgres") {

  #credentials_list <- yaml.load_file(credentials_file)
  credentials_list$drv <- drv

  if (destination=="Dremio") {
    stop("Deprecated.  Dremio no longer uses a pool")
    # DREMIO_DRIVERS <- odbc::odbcListDrivers()
    # DREMIO_DRIVERS <- grep("dremio",DREMIO_DRIVERS$name,ignore.case = T,value=T)
    # credentials_list$DRIVER <- DREMIO_DRIVERS[[1]]
  }

  credentials_list$idleTimeout <- 30

  tryCatch({
    #R.utils::withTimeout({ do.call(dbPool, credentials_list)  },timeout=10,elapsed=10)
      { do.call(dbPool, credentials_list)  }
    },
           error=function(e) {
             warning(conditionMessage(e))
             NULL
           })
}

```{r write-calcs}
 
 calcPool <- dbStart(credentials_list=credentials_list)
 
 pending_calcs <- unlist(calcPool %>% dbGetQuery("
  select count(*)::int as pending 
  from p_rsf.rsf_data_calculation_evaluations
 "))
 
 if(length(pending_calcs) && pending_calcs > 0) {
  message(paste0("There are ",pending_calcs," pending calculations")) 
 }
```

## Job Execution Log

Pending calculations `r as.character(pending_calcs)`
